variables.name: labelValues
variables.expression:
['app' in variables.labels ? variables.labels['app'] : '',
 'component' in variables.labels ? variables.labels['component'] : '',
 'app.kubernetes.io/name' in variables.labels ? variables.labels['app.kubernetes.io/name'] : '']

variables.name: isParentWriterCreate
variables.expression:
request.operation == 'CREATE' && (!has(request.subResource) || request.subResource == '') && request.namespace == 'hcce' && (variables.writerNames.exists(writer, variables.labelValues.exists(value, value == writer)) ||
 (has(variables.pod.spec.serviceAccountName) &&
  variables.pod.spec.serviceAccountName == 'bot-orchestrator') ||
 variables.pod.spec.containers.exists(container, container.name in variables.writerNames) ||
 variables.podNames.exists(value,
   variables.writerNames.exists(writer, value == writer || value.startsWith(writer + '-'))) ||
 (has(variables.pod.metadata.ownerReferences) &&
  variables.pod.metadata.ownerReferences.exists(owner,
    owner.kind == 'ReplicaSet' &&
    variables.writerNames.exists(writer,
      owner.name == writer || owner.name.startsWith(writer + '-')))))

validations.message: recovery operation Pod fence denies database-writer Pod creation while checkpoint or restore is fenced
recovery operation Pod fence denies runner Pod mutation while checkpoint or restore is fenced
